summary_en: 7,500,000 shares (7.5% of shares outstanding), ¥2.8B upper limit, open-market purchase on TSE, Aug 14, 2026 – Jun 30, 2027. Rationale: capital efficiency, per-share value, and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding the determination of matters relating to the acquisition of treasury shares (Acquisition of treasury shares based on the Articles of Incorporation under the provisions of Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: istyle Inc. announced on August 13, 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire its own shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied with modifications by Article 165, Paragraph 3). The acquisition is authorized up to 7,500,000 shares (7.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) with a maximum expenditure of ¥2.8 billion. Shares will be repurchased via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from August 14, 2026 through June 30, 2027. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency, enhance per-share value, and strengthen shareholder returns. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 2,632,770 treasury shares against 100,029,197 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
